parameters.name: api_base_url
parameters.helpText: Base URL of your deployed mock Epic EHR API (no trailing slash).

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.helpText: OAuth access token for the mock Epic EHR API. Obtained automatically via the Authorization Code flow when the app is installed; never readable from app JS.

parameters.name: patient_id_field_id
parameters.helpText: Numeric ID of your 'Patient ID' ticket field (from Admin Center > Objects and rules > Tickets > Fields). Replace the default with your real field ID.
